capabilities: surface notes distilled from Claude Code sessions in a sidebar
query the vir CLI for notes related to the current note
show vir daemon health as a status-bar dot
review, approve or reject notes flagged by vir audit
scan the vault for vir-distilled notes by frontmatter type
disambiguation: Not an in-Obsidian AI assistant; it only displays notes produced by the external vir CLI and does no distilling itself.
extras: Desktop only — the CLI-bound daemon means the plugin does not run on mobile. The Review tab needs vir-cli 0.23.0+. The author links a Ko-fi page for donations and an external manifesto ('The Compounding Codebase') explaining the philosophy behind vir.
problem: Knowledge distilled from Claude Code sessions lives outside the editor, so relevant patterns, gotchas and decisions don't surface while you write in Obsidian.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a thin client over the vir CLI — install and configure it first
vir distills your Claude Code sessions into an Obsidian vault of patterns, gotchas, decisions, and tools

requires.name: vir CLI (vir-cli 0.23.0 or newer, with background daemon)

summary: Sidebar client for the vir CLI that surfaces notes distilled from Claude Code sessions while you edit, with a status-bar daemon indicator.
